CONTEXT.content: AI coding assistants are powerful but dangerous when given vague tasks. Prompt decomposition breaks large requests into specific, verifiable steps — the same skill as engineering planning, applied to AI collaboration.
CONTEXT.analogy: You wouldn't tell a junior engineer 'build the app.' You'd give them a ticket with context, scope, and acceptance criteria. AI needs the same.
CONTEXT.productionNote: Senior engineers using AI ship 3x faster. Juniors using AI ship 3x more bugs. The difference is prompt quality.
hints: What's the worst AI-generated code you've seen? What was wrong with the prompt?

DECIDE.optionA: One detailed prompt with full context, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
DECIDE.optionB: Chain of small prompts: plan first, then implement step by step with verification between each.

tradeoffs.A: Faster for simple tasks; AI may miss constraints in complex ones.
tradeoffs.B: Slower but safer; each step is verifiable before proceeding.

hints: Consider the URL shortener analytics feature from the planning module.

BUILD.goal: Write a prompt chain (3-5 prompts) to implement Slice 1 of link analytics using your AI assistant. Include review checkpoints.

tracks.general: Document the prompts in markdown. Execute at least the first prompt and review the output.

acceptance: Each prompt has: context, scope, constraints, expected output
Review checkpoint after each prompt defines what to verify
First prompt's output was reviewed and meets acceptance criteria
hints: Prompt 1 should be planning only — no code.
Review means reading the output, not just running it.

criteria: Show the output of Prompt 1 and your review notes
Identify one thing the AI got wrong and how your prompt could prevent it
hints: Finding AI mistakes is a skill — it's your job as the engineer.

BREAK.scenario: The AI implemented analytics but used an in-memory store. Your app uses SQLite. Tests pass but data won't persist.
BREAK.symptoms: Code works in dev. Analytics disappear on restart. AI didn't know about your persistence layer.
hints: What context was missing from the prompt?
This is a review failure, not an AI failure.

FIX.goal: Revise your prompt chain to include the missing context. Re-run and verify persistence.
hints: Constraints in prompts prevent entire classes of bugs.
The fix is in the prompt, not just the code.

decisionCallbacks.A: A detailed single prompt might have included persistence — if you remembered to mention it.
decisionCallbacks.B: The chain approach would have caught this at the planning review step before any code was written.
